prompts.facades:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production albedo texture atlas for an existing 3D racing game set in Boxmeer, Netherlands. Generate ONE square image, an EXACT edge-to-edge 4 by 4 grid of sixteen equal square wall textures. No gutters, no margins, no labels, no grid lines. Every cell is a perfectly orthographic, front-on FLAT RECTANGULAR WALL surface from eaves at the top edge to plinth at bottom edge. NO roofs, gables, sky, pavement, trees, people, cars, perspective, cast shadows or projecting side walls. Rich believable small-scale brick, weathered mortar, glass reflections and painted timber; realistic Dutch materials adapted to a crisp late-1990s racing game. Neutral diffuse overcast lighting, consistent physical scale. All windows and doors upright.
Top row left-to-right: 1 warm red brick two-storey bakery-like shop with broad ground-floor glazing and three white sash upper windows; 2 pale cream rendered two-storey flower-shop-like facade with dark green shop frame and three upper windows; 3 rust brown brick bookshop-like front with dark timber broad storefront and three upper windows; 4 ivory classic Dutch brasserie facade, dark green glazed lower conservatory, large white framed upper windows.
Second row: 1 brown brick bicycle-shop-like front with broad blue-grey storefront, three upstairs windows; 2 pale warm stucco clothing-shop-like front with cream trim and large display windows; 3 dark red brick cafe-like front with green joinery, tall upper sash windows; 4 restrained old Dutch cultural-centre-like cream wall with six sash windows and central door.
Third row: four DIFFERENT modest Dutch residential two-storey walls, dark reddish brick, warm brown brick, cream render and red brick respectively, white window frames, front doors, downstairs large picture windows, upstairs two or three smaller windows.
Bottom row: 1 dark brown Dutch suburban brick house wall with cream-framed broad windows and green door; 2 cream brick house wall with large dark-framed picture window; 3 De Meidoorn 1980s Dutch detached brick house wall, two broad white-framed horizontal picture windows one above another on the left, dark green door at bottom right, white fascia at top, dark reddish brown fine brickwork, NO roof in this cell; 4 warm brown brick modern Dutch house wall with asymmetric white windows and ochre timber door.
All sixteen panels fill their cell with building wall. NO readable lettering or signage text anywhere. No real photographic sources: original AI-created imagery only. Make the cell boundaries exactly at 25%, 50%, 75% of the image in both directions.
prompts.landmarks:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production albedo landmark WALL texture atlas for an existing 3D Boxmeer racing game. Generate ONE square image divided into an EXACT 2 by 2 edge-to-edge grid of four equal square textures, no gutters, margins, labels or separator lines. Every panel is a completely orthographic front elevation of ONE FLAT RECTANGULAR WALL plane only, no perspective, no roof, no sky, no street, no cars, no trees, no people, no ground, no shadows from other objects. The four panels must be original AI-created textures, not photographs. Physically believable Dutch architectural materials, fine masonry, gently weathered paint and good clear details suitable for a classic 3D racing game. Neutral diffuse lighting.
TOP LEFT: Boxmeer castle inspired cream-white 18th-century palace wall, two floors, tall narrow white divided-light sash windows, subtle pale pilasters, central dark green double entrance door with carved pale stone rococo coat-of-arms above it, horizontal cornice, stone base. Wall entirely fills square.
TOP RIGHT: Boxmeer Carmelite monastery inspired red-brown fine brick wall, two floors of tall round-arched white-trimmed sash windows, pale horizontal stone band between floors, restrained 17th-century Dutch monastic frontage, stone base.
BOTTOM LEFT: Sint-Petrusbasiliek Boxmeer inspired Romanesque brick BELL TOWER wall segment, three tall narrow dark paired round-arched belfry openings above blind brick arcades, horizontal masonry bands, no roof or spire, no clock, wall fills square.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Sint-Petrusbasiliek nave wall inspired warm brown-red brick, three slender tall Romanesque round-arched stained-glass windows with pale sandstone surrounds, fine small brickwork, restrained horizontal plinth, flat wall fills square. Do not draw buttresses or side surfaces.
Panels divide precisely halfway in both axes. No text.
prompts.materials:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: physically believable seamless albedo material atlas for a Dutch town racing game. ONE square image with an EXACT 4x4 grid of sixteen equal square panels, no borders, margins, labels or grid lines. Each panel is a straight-on FLAT material texture, evenly lit, edge-to-edge continuous pattern, no perspective, no scenes or objects, no shadows or highlights baked from directional lighting. All original AI-created materials, detailed and restrained, realistic Dutch outdoor surfaces for a classic 3D game.
Row 1: 1 fine red-brown Dutch stretcher-bond brick masonry with beige mortar; 2 warm cream painted plaster lightly weathered; 3 dark charcoal slate roof tiles laid in regular small courses; 4 aged terracotta Dutch pantiles in regular small courses.
Row 2: 1 lush woven hawthorn hedge close-up, dense tiny green leaves with partly visible braided brown stems, no gaps or background; 2 short mown temperate green grass viewed directly from above; 3 smooth grey Dutch residential asphalt with very fine aggregate, absolutely NO road markings; 4 grey-beige rectangular Dutch sidewalk pavers in regular staggered rows, viewed from directly above.
Row 3: 1 red-brown clay herringbone street paving viewed directly from above, small individual rectangular bricks, regular uninterrupted pattern; 2 muted blue-green calm river water viewed directly from above with small subtle ripples, no land or reflections of buildings; 3 pale grey limestone blocks fine joints; 4 white painted masonry with tiny weathering.
Row 4: 1 dark green painted wooden vertical door boards; 2 warm brown timber boards; 3 blue-black solar panel module with thin regular silver cell grid, no frame perspective; 4 pale sand and fine gravel.
Preserve exact regular panel divisions at 25%, 50%, 75%. No text or objects. The materials must work when cropped individually and repeated.
